007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ExecutionStateRequest;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamExecutionState;
014
015/** Updates an owner-scoped team's execution state. */
016public final class SetOwnedTeamExecutionStateSample {
017
018    private SetOwnedTeamExecutionStateSample() {
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * Loads the named team and updates the requested conversation state.
023     *
024     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
025     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
026     */
027    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
028        String teamName = AgentLifecycleSampleSupport.requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_NAME");
029        String conversationId = AgentLifecycleSampleSupport.requiredEnv(
030                "SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_CONVERSATION_ID");
031        TeamExecutionState state = TeamExecutionState.of(
032                envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_TEAM_EXECUTION_STATE", "SUCCEEDED"));
033        try (SelectAIAgent client = AgentLifecycleSampleSupport.createClient()) {
034            Team team = client.team(teamName);
035            boolean updated = team.setExecutionState(ExecutionStateRequest.builder(state)
036                    .conversationId(conversationId)
037                    .build());
038            System.out.printf("Updated owned team %s execution state for conversation %s: %s%n",
039                    teamName, conversationId, updated);
040        }
041    }
042
043    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
044        String value = System.getenv(name);
045        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
046    }
047}
